subject: Acme trial — procurement & billing path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme trial — procurement & billing path

Hi Alex / Procurement team —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the follow-ups I promised:

- Trial scope: 10k tokens/day for the next 30 days, access to the Redwood hosted API with logging turned on for success metrics.
- Success criteria you mentioned: 80% intent extraction accuracy on inbound chat logs and <200ms median token latency for live traffic.
- Next steps from our side: share the standard DPA + quote and confirm billing start triggers.

Question for procurement: do you require a PO for payment, or will a corporate card be used? Also, are you interested in procuring via AWS Marketplace (we can provide a marketplace quote) or do you need a standard vendor invoice?

For trial-to-paid conversion, customers typically choose one of these flows:
- Start billing on day 31 automatically if trial usage meets the mutual success criteria.
- Start billing on a mutually agreed start date once PO is in place (preferred by many procurement teams).

Action items:
1) Alex / Procurement: confirm PO vs card and marketplace interest.
2) Neha / Finance (cc'd): I will send a quote + DPA to loop in legal if PO path.
3) Alex: confirm the success criteria threshold to trigger conversion (numbers above ok?).

I'll attach the DPA and a preliminary quote in my next email.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143
[attachment: redwood-dpa.pdf]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & billing path

Thanks Marissa —

This looks good. A few notes from procurement:

- We prefer to pay via PO whenever possible.
- We will need a signed DPA and a vendor W-9 (if applicable) before finance issues the PO.
- We evaluate marketplace purchases occasionally, but for platform pilots like this we usually go direct to Redwood (vendor invoice + PO).

On success criteria: the numbers you proposed are fine. To be explicit: we want >=80% intent extraction and median token latency under 300ms in our test harness. If those are met, we'll prioritize conversion to paid.

Can you send the quote and the DPA? Also pls include the billing contact for the invoice.

Best,
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement & billing path

Alex — thanks for the quick response and clarifying procurement's needs.

Summary and next steps:
- PO path accepted. We will attach: 1) Redwood DPA (attached) and 2) vendor W-9 via secure link.
- I'll attach a formal quote (quote-RD-2027-ACME-0032.pdf) that includes the monthly pricing and estimated tokens based on your forecast. If procurement wants line-item pricing for a PO, Neha can walk through that.
- Billing contact for invoices: accounting@acme.com (please confirm if different).

Trial-to-paid specifics:
- Conversion trigger: if trial metrics meet success criteria within 30 days, we will convert to the paid plan and start invoicing according to the PO effective date.
- Billing start options (pick one):
  a) Start billing on the 31st day after trial start automatically if success criteria met.
  b) Start billing on the PO effective date (if PO is backdated or specifies a start date).

Recommend: confirm PO effective date. If you want us to align billing to the PO date, we'll include that field on the quote and DocuSign envelope.

Attachments included: redwood-dpa.pdf; quote-RD-2027-ACME-0032.pdf

Next actions:
- Alex / Procurement: confirm billing contact and PO timeline.
- Neha: I sent the quote to procurement and will draft the PO-ready invoice language if you want to review.

Thanks — copying Neha and Vivek to keep finance/legal in the loop.
